reviews.text:
I took my Maine Coon kitten to have several knots cut out around his paws, and he came out looking great, very handsome, and knot-free, which was the most important thing!

I highly recommend her; the woman is lovely and you can tell she adores animals. She treated my cat with so much love.
Excellent service to my cat and me. Very professional. I will definitely return. It's important to maintain good grooming habits. Thank you.
I'll definitely be back, I loved how it turned out.
The service is very friendly, they make you feel comfortable.

I have to say I took my cat there because of the reviews, but I wasn't very confident they could cut his hair without anesthesia. But as soon as I walked into the shop, I understood the reviews. It's amazing how this woman treats and trains the animals. The work she does is invaluable. Thank you so much!

It was my first time there. I have a Westie, and few places do a good stripping job, so I went to see what they did. They did a gorgeous job; it was one of the best stripping jobs she's ever had. I highly recommend this place. They were very friendly.
Phenomenal

Dear customer, we regret that your review was not positive and we are sorry we did not meet your expectations. We would like to hear more details about your experience to understand what happened and how we can improve. We invite you to contact us directly so we can address your case with the utmost attention. Sincerely, the Mix Peludos Cat and Dog Grooming Team.

It was my first time there and I'm delighted, everything was great. I have a Persian cat and he's fantastic. They had to cut all his fur because it was so matted, and I always used to take them to the vet and they had to anesthetize them, but here they did it perfectly and without anesthesia. Tina, thank you so much for everything, let's stay in touch! 👌

I took my cat in with a large knot on his back, and they did a fantastic job! They're incredibly kind, and I was so happy. They were very professional, and above all, I was able to see him looking his best without sedation. I'll definitely be back.

At first I had my doubts, but I quickly realized they know how to handle animals. My kitten was calm the entire time they were deshedding her; they treated her with great care and expertise. I was so happy! I'll definitely take her back… 100% recommended!
Dear Antonio, thank you so much for your 5-star rating. We appreciate your trust and remain at your service to care for your pet whenever needed. Sincerely, the Mix Peludos Cat and Dog Grooming team.

They were so kind and my dog ​​looked adorable!

Thank you so much!

It was a great experience taking our dog Luna there; they always make her look so beautiful, and the cologne they use afterward smells wonderful. We're so happy with Luna's haircut. And the service is excellent. We'll be back soon! 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻😊😊😊 …

I took my Westie for a stripping and I'm very unhappy. His face is thinner, they removed all the volume, but they barely touched up his body and he looks like a barrel. The stripping itself didn't convince me, but the result is just unsightly. I won't be doing it again.

Dear Gema,

We sincerely regret that your experience at MixPeludos did not meet your expectations, especially given your low rating.

We strive to provide the best care and service to all pets, so we would really appreciate knowing exactly what happened during your visit or service.

Please call us directly at 640 51 82 75 or email us at info@mixpeludos.es (including your name and your pet's name) so we can review your case in detail and find a solution.

We want to ensure that all our customers and their companions receive 5-star service. Thank you for helping us improve.
They did a fantastic job on my Saturnino, 100% recommended!

Wonderful experience. Besides doing me a huge favor, they treated my kitten wonderfully. I was pleasantly surprised by both the care and the service. You can tell when there's love for animals, and there was plenty here. I'm not giving it a 10 because Google won't let me.
I couldn't be happier with the way they leave my dog ​​every time I take him here. It's amazing how well they treat him and how beautiful they leave him. THANK YOU.
Professional barbers, I loved your work, very nice, I wish you all the best.

Excellent! After searching for a long time for a cat groomer, I found Mix Peludos, who managed to make her look perfect without anesthesia. Very good work and professionalism. Thank you for your patience; it's clear you love your work and animals.

I took my 4-year-old dog to the groomer for the first time. I've always groomed her at home because she's timid, but we decided to give it a try. 10/10! They were lovely, greeted Luna with so much love, and made her look like a little teddy bear 🥹 She's gorgeous! We've already booked an appointment for September and everything 🤣. Without a doubt, the best!
Thank you so much for your feedback, Rafa :)
Great experience for everyone who goes! Water dogs that other places would shave, here they give them a quick trim! Great treatment for all our beloved pets!

I discovered this cat groomer and I wouldn't trade it for anything. The service was incredibly friendly, and most importantly, my kitten left feeling super happy and refreshed. We're definitely going back this year. It's so nice to find people like this these days.
Excellent service

I've been back several times and will keep coming back. They leave my cat looking perfect! 🤩 My cat is 16 years old and doesn't groom herself like she used to; she gets a lot of knots. When I give her a trim, her fur grows back beautifully and is incredibly soft, and she's much more lively. …

Let's see, I trusted this groomer for the second time and it seems to get worse every day. My dog ​​came out crying, he looked in the mirror and didn't recognize himself. They charged me 60 euros. Thanks for ruining my dog's life. Now I can't even get with the other female dogs. And finally, his fellow dogs have kicked him out of the pack. I'll come back again. Great service.
Lovely service! I would definitely recommend!
Great, we've been several times and they leave the dog perfectly clean!
Rare Dogs That Are Born Once Every 1000 Years - YouTube

We took Lucky for the first time today, a Persian cat who rarely lets anyone brush him. He had quite a few knots and a lot of loose fur. We were surprised by how quickly and well they treated him and how easy they were to handle him. Thank you so much for everything, he looks absolutely gorgeous and feels so comfortable. We'll definitely be back! 🥰

This is the second time I've been to Mix Peludos, this time taking my cat Monono, a Persian with lots of mats. I'm very happy with the care he received and the results. Both Tina and her daughter made my boy look gorgeous. Now I can play with him and pet him; what they do for the animals is incredible. I recommend them 100%.

We're very happy with the result. My cat had dreadlock-like knots on her back, and we thought they'd have to shave her, but the person in charge at this center was able to remove them perfectly. She also bathed and dried her fur without …
The owner is lovely; she trimmed my daughter's two-week-old kitten's nails and accepted a donation. You can tell she enjoys her work by the way she treats the animals.
A place where they treat Dana wonderfully. Very professional and with great affection for the animals. I'll keep coming back.
Great with my kittens. I recommend it 100%.
Thank you for your feedback, Alberto.

I was there yesterday with my cat. I had a misunderstanding about the time and arrived late, but the staff were incredibly kind and made sure I had an appointment. I'm so grateful to them in every way!
Excellent service!

Don't take your pets to this unhygienic place. The elderly lady who served me was incredibly rude; she questioned whether I was a hairdresser for asking about products. She should retire, and before she does, she should clean all the products. The whole place is disgusting.
